title.ko: 개인정보 보호책임자의 성명 또는 개인정보 업무 담당부서 및 고충사항을 처리하는 부서에 관한 사항

rules.element: officer name or department, with contact
rules.statement: State the name of the privacy officer designated under PIPA 31, or the name of the department handling privacy work and related complaints, with a contact such as a phone number.
Give both a phone number and an e-mail address.
The contact must actually work for inquiries and complaints and must not obstruct rights (unreachable or excessively delayed).
Give both the officer (name, contact) and the department (name, contact).

rules.element: officer shown = officer designated and reported (large processors)
rules.statement: For processors meeting the Decree 32(3) criteria (annual revenue over KRW 180B with 50k+ data subjects' sensitive or unique-ID data or 1M+ data subjects; universities with 20k+ students; tertiary hospitals; public system operators), designation, change or removal of the privacy officer needs a board resolution (corporations) and a report to PIPC within 6 months. The officer shown in the policy must be the officer currently designated through that process, and the policy is updated when the designation changes. The Act does not require the board resolution or the report itself to appear in the policy; do not add such text.
rules.sourceSpan: n/a (statute text, not in the 2026.4 guideline)

rules.element: officer duties described with the amended list
rules.statement: If the policy describes the privacy officer's duties, it must not present the pre-2026-09-11 list as complete. The amended PIPA 31(4) adds management of privacy staff and budget, and reporting to the business owner or representative and the board, alongside planning, periodic review, complaint handling and redress, internal controls, training, and file management. Describing duties is optional; if present, use the amended list or a non-exhaustive wording.
rules.sourceSpan: n/a (statute text, not in the 2026.4 guideline)

rules.element: small business: owner or representative is the officer
rules.statement: A processor that is a small business (소상공인, Decree 32(1)) may skip designating a privacy officer; the business owner or representative is then the officer by law (PIPA 31(2)). The policy then shows the owner or representative (by title placeholder) as the officer, or the department and contact under PIPA 30(1)6. Pre-existing rule, verified in the current text; not new in Act 21445.
rules.sourceSpan: n/a (statute text, not in the 2026.4 guideline)

piiHandling: Names and direct contacts are placeholders in drafts (R4.3: contact refs only); the operator fills them after legal review.
goodPatterns: Clause 1: officer designated to oversee processing and handle complaints and remedies; officer block (name, title, contact) and department block (name, contact). Clause 2: all privacy inquiries go to the officer or department and are answered without delay.

commonDefects.defect: Neither officer nor department contact given.
Only a generic customer-center number that does not handle privacy requests.

needsVerification.note: Spike: Act 21445 (in force 2026-09-11) strengthened Art. 31 (CPO designation, board resolution and report to PIPC for large processors). Not reflected in the 2026.4 guideline; policy-content impact unknown. Kept out of rules pending review.
needsVerification.resolution: Act 21445 text read via the law.go.kr API: no change to mandatory policy items (PIPA 30, Decree 31); officer-related rules R-S18-005 to R-S18-007 added as beyondGuideline.

lawUpdate2026.policyContentChange: None to the list of mandatory policy items: PIPA 30 and Decree 31 are unchanged in the current text (article change flag N) and match the prior versions.
newDuties: PIPA 30-3 (new): the business owner or representative is the final responsible person and must fund staff and budget. No policy item.
PIPA 31(3) (new) and Decree 32(3)-(4): board resolution and PIPC report for large processors (R-S18-005).

PIPA 34 (amended): breach notification extended to forgery, alteration or damage, plus a 'possible leak' notice. Not a policy item; relevant to S20 remedies wording only if the policy restates notification duties.
